properties.baseline_rule_zh: 普通通行、静态导向、休息和人工求助先行；AI增益不得占用无障碍净宽或取消无账号服务。
properties.baseline_rule_en: Ordinary passage, static wayfinding, rest and staffed help come first; AI boost may not occupy accessible clear width or remove account-free service.
properties.exit_rule_zh: 模型、网络、传感器和执行器可物理拔除；场地、数据与维护责任必须归还。
properties.exit_rule_en: Model, network, sensors and actuators can be physically unplugged; space, data and maintenance responsibility must be returned.
